basic_info.description: ** Welcome to this Fantastic Outer Mission Home! ** Partially detached and situated on an oversized lot, this 2br/2ba home shows pride ownership throughout. With a first offering in 60+ years, this well maintained home boasts great space with an attractive floorplan, and offers easy living for today's homebuyer to enjoy.  Features include an updated chef's kitchen with quartz counters and stainless appliances, +/- 1,783 sq. ft. of living space, and a large lower area presents added space options.  So much to see, ....don't miss this one in your search!
